description: Takes the full text of the old and the new version of a contract or of terms and conditions. Splits both into sections (§, numbered clauses, articles or paragraphs), matches them by wording, number and similarity and returns per section: unchanged, renumbered only, changed (with the sentences before and now and the figures, deadlines and dates that differ), new or removed. Changes to price, payment and discount, term and termination, liability, penalties, warranty, non-solicitation, confidentiality, jurisdiction and travel expenses are marked red, as is new strict wording such as unlimited, excluded or automatic. Ends with ready questions for the other side. It shows what changed in the wording, not what it means legally; for a legal view of one contract use review_contract. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

new_text.description: Full text of the new version.

old_text.description: Full text of the old (previous) version.
